Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Shubham Bhardwaj, learned 
counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Sahil Mullick, learned counsel for 
the respondent.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner 
contends that as per Clause 33 of the Bye￾Laws of the Trust, suit has to be filed only in 
the name of ‘General Secretary’, while the 
suit in question was filed in the name of 
‘Manager of the Trust’. However, this aspect 
was overlooked by learned trial court.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent 
prays for and is granted two weeks time to 
file counter affidavit.
5. List this case on 03.11.2026.
6. In the meantime, proceedings of the 
suit may go on; however, judgment shall not 
be pronounced.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 06.10.2026
Aswal
